surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 19 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Infitaar (The Cleaving) is the 82th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 19 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْفَطَرَتْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اذا السماء انفطرت
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the sky is torn apart

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the stars fall, scattering
And when the seas are erupted
And when the [contents of] graves are scattered
A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: each soul will know what it has done and what it has left undone

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا ايها الانسان ما غرك بربك الكريم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Mankind, what has lured you away from God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: your generous Lord, who created you, shaped you, proportioned you

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةࣲ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: في اي صورة ما شاء ركبك
ayahs.translation_saheeh: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you
No! But you deny the Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yet you still take the Judgement to be a lie

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the good will live in bliss

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the wicked will burn in the Fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will enter it on the Day of Judgement

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And never therefrom will they be absent
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and they will find no escape

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ مَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم ما ادراك ما يوم الدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yes! What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسࣱ لِّنَفۡسࣲ شَيۡـࣰٔ اۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا ۖ وَالْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم لا تملك نفس لنفس شيئا ۖ والامر يومئذ لله
ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Day when no soul will be able to do anything for another; on that Day, command will belong to God
